entries.title: Nebuchadnezzar
entries.definitive_edition: Nebuchadnezzar: Sargon's Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the native Windows PC release; no emulation is needed.

primary.version: Sargon's Edition / current PC release with The Adventures of Sargon DLC
primary.why: Nebuchadnezzar is available for Windows and Linux, and a Sargon's Edition bundle contains the base game plus The Adventures of Sargon DLC. Windows PC is the primary because it is the standard native PC route and can be bought as the complete package with the expansion content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows PC release on Steam, ideally via the Sargon's Edition bundle or with The Adventures of Sargon DLC installed.

all_releases.fidelity: Native Windows PC release with optional Steam Workshop support and DLC.
all_releases.reason: primary: complete native PC route, including the Sargon's Edition bundle for base game plus DLC.
skip: no exclusive content; use Windows PC for the primary complete package unless Linux is the required local platform.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The Windows and Linux releases have the same game content; the completeness question is DLC, not a platform split.

entries.remaster_caveats: The Adventures of Sargon is expansion DLC rather than a remaster; install it with the base game for the most complete version.
